Exhaustive finite computations check independent matrix enumerations; they are not used to prove the general case.

value.rationale: A complete, all-odd-prime, all-rank joint fixed-point and image-size distribution refines a natural finite-group endomorphism invariant already studied in the primary algebra literature. Its fixed-point-free slice is concretely motivated by established constructions of Yang--Baxter solutions; it quantifies labelled starting maps without overclaiming distinct solutions. The independent-rank restriction and Gaussian subspace inversion explain the nonroutine new strata beyond earlier marginals.
